name: Snover
description: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Leafage
moves.description: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.description: The user attacks by harshly dropping large icicles onto the target.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the target. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user.
